_doc: W5 default maps (SPEC 3, 12). decorCull: per asset category ("categories") or asset id ("assets", wins over its category), instances are not drawn beyond clamp(perMetre * largest bound extent, min, max) metres from the camera (editor and explore). Keeps the default maps' draw count inside the frame budget; buildings, bunkers, guns and vehicles are never culled by this rule. Tuned on Omaha (--selftest-maps): hedgerow and tree foliage is drawn in the main and all shadow passes, so its distance dominates the frame; in bocage the next hedge hides what lies beyond it.
